quote: WaveFM for the mel-spectrogram conditioned speech synthesis task.
We propose WaveFM, a high-fidelity vocoder for speech synthesis conditioned on mel-spectrograms.

Additionally, we incorporate objective automatic metrics to assess sample quality, including Multi-resolution STFT (M-STFT) loss, Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), Mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) with dynamic time warping, Periodicity error, and the F1 score for voiced/unvoiced (V/UV) classification.
